issuer.summary: Lido DAO has a substantial staking operating record, public governance and operator disclosures. The reviewed interface terms do not establish a universal corporate repayment guarantor, independent claim priority or insurance. Interface restrictions and dispute provisions are separate from the on-chain withdrawal claim.
facts: The native holder unwraps to stETH. ETH settlement requires a separate queue request, finalization and claim.
The reviewed MetaMask Staking incident thread ended with the October 23 allocation-limit update. Final penalty, compensation and re-entry reconciliation remains incomplete.
Historical operator reimbursement does not guarantee compensation for future staking losses.
issuer.summary_source: November 17 Ethereum wstETH assessment and November 18 holder-rights clarification. The latter did not renew financial or authority observations.
